capabilities: Render svg code fences as inline graphics in Reading View and Live Preview
Toggle between the rendered graphic and the raw SVG source by clicking
Copy SVG source to the clipboard
Sanitize SVG before rendering, stripping scripts, event handlers, and dangerous URIs
Optionally block external resource URLs referenced by the SVG
disambiguation: Renders SVG written in code fences inside notes; it is not a viewer for .svg files stored in the vault.
extras: The plugin is unreviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is manual (from release files or building from source), and the README documents its sanitization rules in a Security section.
problem: Obsidian shows SVG markup in code fences as plain text, so displaying an inline vector graphic requires saving and attaching a separate file.
summary: Renders SVG code fences as live inline graphics in Reading View and Live Preview, with click-to-source, copy, and sanitization of dangerous SVG content.
